labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Orange is already available through Rich colour names and hex values, so this is a usage question.

body:
Rich already supports orange text. Use a colour name in markup, such as `[orange1]text[/]`, `[orange3]text[/]` or `[dark_orange]text[/]`, or a hex value such as `[#ff8700]text[/]`. The full list of names is in https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/appendix/colors.rst

For further usage questions, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
